resources.string: No Apple Watch is paired with this iPhone.
Phase Wake on the watch
Install Phase Wake on your Apple Watch in the Watch app.
Alarms allowed
Allow Phase Wake to set alarms so your iPhone can ring as a backup alarm.
Start nightstand mode
For the sunrise, leave Phase Wake open on the charger overnight. The screen stays dark until the light begins.
Stays on all night – put your iPhone on the charger.
Everything stays on your phone and watch. No account, no server, no tracking.
End

Your iPhone can only show the light while Phase Wake is open – start nightstand mode before you go to sleep.
Sleep duration and regularity come from Apple Health.
Open Phase Wake before you go to sleep so your watch can arm the alarm.
Alarm armed on the watch
Open Phase Wake on your Apple Watch before you go to sleep. watchOS only arms the alarm while the app is open.
Apple Watch: alarm not armed – notification only, no sleep phases. Open the watch app.
Tap to arm your alarm for tonight.
First %1$d min not measured – the Apple Watch only measures the last %2$d min before the target.

Apple Health
Nights from Apple Health and other apps can show up here too. To see them, compare with health data.
No sleep data from Apple Health yet. Sleep has to be recorded there, for example by your Apple Watch, and Phase Wake must be allowed to read it in the Health app.
Nights from other apps (e.g. Apple Health) aren’t backed up – they stay there and show up again once access is granted.

Phase Wake can read the sleep data that your health app (for example Apple Health) stores. It is shown in your history, also for comparison with the nights Phase Wake woke you. Phase Wake only reads, never writes, and nothing leaves your phone.
Notifications on the watch
Allow time-sensitive notifications for Phase Wake on your Apple Watch. Otherwise it can’t wake you by notification when no measurement is running.
Your watch didn’t start the measurement before sleep – Phase Wake isn’t allowed to read motion data on it. Allow it in the watch’s settings under Privacy. You’ll still be woken.
Watch status is out of date – briefly open Phase Wake on the watch.

Counts from when you fall asleep – tap “Good night” on your watch when you go to bed. On Apple Watch, Phase Wake estimates when you fall asleep from your learned time to fall asleep. Without the tap, the set time applies.
Open Phase Wake on your Apple Watch from 1 hour before bedtime (it reminds you) and it records your movement from then until your wake window; then Phase Wake works out when you fell asleep.
